items.title: 1 Healthcare Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Healthcare companies are pushing the status quo by innovating in areas like drug development and digital health. Shareholders who bet on the industry have been rewarded lately as healthcare stocks have returned 23.2% over the past six months, topping the S&P 500 by 11.5 percentage points.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stock Recovered Before Its Margins Did
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) stock has gained about 41% since early March, and at roughly $400 a share the market has already paid for a recovery. The easy reading is that the turnaround is finished. It is not. One half got better over those six months, the other got worse, and the price reflects the good half.
